messages:
joan_devx: FYI I'm opening a docs PR to split the Optimize Toolkit into three focused pages — batching, caching, quant profiles — and add a short migration how-to + runnable SDK examples. PR coming in ~15m.

liam_eng: awesome. can you include a tiny node/python example for streaming + batching? those are the ones that trip people up.

joan_devx: yes — planning one-liners + a runnable gist. sample python snippet:

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
# enable batching + prefetch
resp = c.generate(model='redwood/fast-13b', prompt='translate: hello', batching=True, cache_prefetch=True)
print(resp.text)
```

samir_docs: I'll own quant profiles content. want me to add a table comparing int8/int4 with perf numbers + eval notes?

marie_pm: pls include recommended defaults by workload (low-latency chat vs high-throughput embedding pipelines). also add a migration checklist for Dedicated customers.

alex_infra: Heads up — links to the internal quantbench repo will need the private link guard. i'll add a redirect in infra so public docs point to the summary page.

joan_devx: good call @alex_infra — I'll leave a TODO in the PR for the redirect and note which sections should be gated.

liam_eng: quick question: for the caching section, can we add an example of KV-prefetch policy config? small sample config would help.

joan_devx: yes. sample YAML planned:

```yaml
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  policy: top_k
  k: 16
  ttl: 300
```

samir_docs: also marking quant examples with labels: `q8_default`, `q4_aggressive` so we can link code samples to profiles.

docs-bot: CI check — lint passed, links analyzer found 1 broken link (internal/quantbench -> needs redirect)

joan_devx: great — I'll fix the link before merging. who's up for a quick review after I push?

liam_eng: me for SDK snippets

samir_docs: me for quant text

marie_pm: i'll do product signoff once samples land

joan_devx: thanks team — pushing PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987

liam_eng: :rocket:

samir_docs: :+1:
